课程简介（中文）

    跨学科视角探讨癌症这一不仅关乎生命医学，更深刻影响社会、文化与伦理的问题。课程内容涵盖癌症的科学原理、流行趋势、历史沿革、社会影响、伦理困境以及在文学与大众媒体中的呈现。学生将通过剖析真实案例、研读科学文献、探讨人文叙事及参与跨文化讨论等，理解癌症如何受到社会因素的影响，并反映出社会对健康挑战的态度与应对方式。

    作为一门复旦大学本科生通识核心课程，本课程适用于所有专业学生，不要求医学或理工背景。课程以英文授课，强调批判性思维、科学素养、人文关怀与全球视野的融合，旨在培养具备跨学科理解力、社会责任意识与道德判断能力的新时代公民。

课程简介（英文）

    This course takes an interdisciplinary approach to cancer, exploring it not only as a biomedical condition but also as a deeply social, cultural, and ethical phenomenon. Topics include the scientific basis of cancer, global trends, historical developments, societal impacts, ethical dilemmas, and representations in literature and popular media. Students will, through analyzing real cases, reviewing scientific literature, exploring human narratives, and engaging in cross-cultural discussions, understand how cancer is influenced by societal factors and reflects society’s attitudes and responses to health challenges.

    As a general education core course at Fudan University, this class is open to undergraduate students of all majors, with no prior background in medicine or science required. Taught in English, it emphasizes the integration of critical thinking, scientific literacy, humanistic reflection, and global awareness, aiming to foster interdisciplinary understanding, ethical reasoning, and social responsibility.

教学目标

本课程旨在帮助学生在以下三个层面实现能力与素养的提升：

知识目标：通过学习，学生能够正确阐述癌症的基本科学机制（如细胞突变、肿瘤发生、治疗原理等），分析癌症在全球与中国的流行趋势，并且概述主要预防方式与治疗进展。

能力目标：通过学习，学生能够应用科学方法与批判性思维分析癌症相关话题；能识别癌症报道中的误导信息；提升英文阅读、口头表达与学术写作能力；在小组合作中进行跨学科研究并发表观点。

价值目标：通过学习，学生能够形成正确的道德判断能力，面对如患者知情权、生命末期决策、医疗公平等伦理议题能形成自我立场；发展对患者处境的同理心，增强服务社会、关爱他人的责任意识；理解全球健康不平等现象，反思科学、文化与社会之间的相互关系，提升伦理认知和人文关怀意识。

 

This course is designed to help students achieve the following across three domains:

Knowledge Objectives:

Through study, students will be able to accurately explain the basic scientific mechanisms of cancer (e.g., cellular mutations, tumorigenesis, treatment principles), analyze global and Chinese epidemiological trends of cancer, and summarize key prevention methods and therapeutic advancements.

Competency Objectives:

Through study, students will be able to apply scientific methods and critical thinking to analyze cancer-related topics; identify misleading information in cancer reports; enhance English reading, oral communication, and academic writing skills; conduct interdisciplinary research in group collaborations and articulate perspectives.

Values Objectives:

Through study, students will develop the ability to form sound ethical judgments, establishing personal stances on ethical issues such as patients’ right to know, end-of-life decision-making, and healthcare equity. They will cultivate empathy for patients’ experiences, strengthen their sense of responsibility to serve society and care for others, understand global health inequalities, reflect on the interplay between science, culture, and society, and elevate their ethical awareness and humanistic concern.

教学方式

本课程采用多种教学方法，强调以学生为中心、跨学科融合和实践体验：

（1）互动式讲授与小组讨论

每周课程结合简明的概念讲授与富有引导性的小组讨论，鼓励学生就科学原理、社会议题与伦理困境提出问题、表达观点、形成思辨能力。讨论过程中鼓励中英文交替表达，以增强语言实践与跨文化理解。引入翻转课堂和Jigsaw小组讨论。

（2）案例教学与现实情境分析

课程广泛采用真实案例（如患者故事、医学伦理争议、政策制定过程等），引导学生从不同角度分析问题，并提出基于科学与价值判断的解决思路。在处理真实案例时，通过AI工具（如DeepSeek等*），学生可以检索大量相关文献与数据，自动生成案例背景材料和统计图表，从而促进基于证据的讨论。AI辅助工具还可以通过自然语言处理技术分析患者叙事和媒体报道，为课堂讨论提供多维度解读。

（3）嘉宾讲座与专题访谈

邀请来自医学、公共卫生、伦理学、患者组织等领域的校内外嘉宾（如肿瘤科医生、癌症幸存者、社会工作者等）进行演讲或访谈，拓展学生视野，增强现实联系。学生可利用DeepSeek等自动搜索相关主题的最新文章，并借助智能摘要引导讨论。此外，学生可以在讲座后使用AI工具进行延伸学习，获取更多跨学科信息。

（4）跨专业小组项目与展示

学生以3–5人为单位组成跨专业小组，就“癌症与社会”相关议题开展独立研究，完成一项以口头展示为主、书面资料为辅的学期项目。项目过程中将提供阶段性指导与同伴反馈，培养合作、研究与表达能力。

（5）多媒体与参与式学习

课程融合图表、新闻报道、纪录片片段、文艺作品（如小说、诗歌、影视剧等），通过头脑风暴、模拟角色扮演、批判性写作等方式，并且引入AI测评和案例分析等，全面激发学生兴趣，拓展学习路径。

（*复旦大学已经部署了校内本地化DeepSeek-R1大语言模型提供师生们辅助教学。）

 

This course employs a variety of interactive and student-centered teaching methods, with a strong focus on interdisciplinary learning and real-world engagement:

  1. Interactive Lectures & Guided Discussions

Each week combines concise conceptual lectures with structured small-group discussions. Students are encouraged to pose questions, debate perspectives, and develop analytical thinking around scientific, social, and ethical topics. Discussions may involve both English and bilingual (Chinese-English) exchange to promote language fluency and cultural understanding. The flipped classroom method and Jigsaw group discussion will be utilized.

  1. Case-Based Learning & Real-World Scenarios

The course extensively employs real-life cases—such as patient stories, controversies in medical ethics, and policy-making processes—to guide students in analyzing issues from various perspectives and proposing solutions based on scientific evidence and value judgments. When handling these real cases, students can leverage AI tools (e.g., DeepSeek*) to retrieve a wealth of relevant literature and data, automatically generate case background materials and statistical charts, thereby promoting evidence-based discussions. Moreover, AI-assisted tools can analyze patient narratives and media reports using natural language processing technology, providing multidimensional interpretations for classroom discussions.

  1. Guest Speakers & Interviews

Invite guest speakers from various fields—including medicine, public health, ethics, and patient advocacy (such as oncologists, cancer survivors, social workers, etc.)—to deliver lectures or participate in interviews, thereby broadening students’ perspectives and reinforcing real-world connections. Students can utilize AI tools like DeepSeek to automatically search for the latest articles on relevant topics and use intelligent summaries to guide discussions. Additionally, after the lectures, students may leverage AI tools for extended learning to acquire more interdisciplinary information.

  1. Cross-Disciplinary Group Project & Presentation

Students collaborate in small, interdisciplinary groups (3–5 members) on a research-based project related to “oncology and society.” The project culminates in an in-class presentation (with supporting written materials), and includes milestones for feedback and instructor guidance. This process develops teamwork, inquiry, and communication skills.

  1. Multimedia & Active Learning Techniques

The course integrates charts, news reports, documentary clips, and literary/artistic works (e.g., novels, poetry, films, TV dramas). Through brainstorming sessions, simulated role-playing, critical writing exercises, and the introduction of AI-based assessments and case studies, it comprehensively stimulates student interest and expands learning pathways.

(*Fudan University has deployed an on-campus localized DeepSeek-R1 large language model to provide teaching assistance for both faculty and students.)
